title: Best Intercom Alternatives in 2026: Namiru.ai vs Intercom vs Zendesk vs Tidio | Namiru.ai

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's own page says Intercom charges $29-132 per seat plus $0.99 per AI resolution.
facts.value: $29-132 per seat plus $0.99 per AI resolution
facts.quote: Intercom charges $29-132 per seat plus $0.99 per AI resolution.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Zendesk starts at $55 per agent.
facts.quote: Zendesk starts at $55 per agent.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Intercom's Essential plan starts at $29 per seat per month.
facts.quote: Intercom's Essential plan starts at $29 per seat per month

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Intercom's AI agent Fin charges $0.99 per resolution.
facts.quote: Intercom's AI agent Fin charges $0.99 per resolution.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that, for 3 agents on Intercom's Advanced plan, seats alone cost $255 per month.
facts.quote: With 3 agents on the Advanced plan, you pay $255/month for seats alone.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Intercom product tours or surveys are a $99/month add-on.
facts.quote: Want product tours or surveys? That is a $99/month add-on.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page estimates a realistic monthly Intercom bill for a small team at $400 to $1,500 depending on AI usage and messaging volume.
facts.quote: A realistic monthly bill for a small team: $400 to $1,500 depending on AI usage and messaging volume.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Zendesk Suite Team starts at $55 per agent per month, so 3 agents cost $165 per month.
facts.quote: Zendesk Suite Team starts at $55 per agent per month. For 3 agents, the base cost is $165/month.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Zendesk's Professional plan runs $115 per agent.
facts.quote: The Professional plan runs $115/agent, putting 3 agents at $345/month.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Intercom's Advanced or Expert plan is required for advanced analytics at $85-132 per seat.
facts.quote: Intercom has some analytics, but they require the Advanced or Expert plan at $85-132/seat.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Tidio's Starter plan costs $29 per month and caps AI chatbot conversations.
facts.quote: The Starter plan at $29/month gives you more, but AI chatbot conversations are capped.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Tidio's Communicator plan costs $29 per operator per month.
facts.quote: The Communicator plan adds live chat features at $29/month per operator.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Tidio's free plan is limited to 20 conversations.
facts.quote: Tidio starts with a free plan but limits you to 20 conversations.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that its free plan includes 20 conversations per month with a full analytics dashboard.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 20 conversations per month with a full analytics dashboard.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that its Starter plan costs €29 per month and includes 2,000 AI conversations.
facts.quote: The Starter plan at €29/month includes 2,000 AI conversations, custom themes, and email support.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that its Pro plan costs €59 per month and adds 5,000 conversations.
facts.quote: The Pro plan at €59/month adds 5,000 conversations, unlimited agents and domains, and removes Namiru branding.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Intercom and Zendesk each offer a 14-day trial rather than a free plan.
facts.quote: Free plan | 20 conversations/mo | No (14-day trial) | No (14-day trial) | Limited free plan

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that Namiru.ai supports 200+ languages with automatic detection, while Intercom supports 45+, Zendesk 40+ and Tidio 16 according to the same comparison table.
facts.quote: Namiru.ai supports 200+ languages with automatic detection.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page claims that its AI agent knows a business's content within 30 seconds after the user pastes a website URL.
facts.quote: Your AI agent knows your business, your products, your pricing, and your policies within 30 seconds.

facts.fact: Namiru.ai's page states that a basic Tidio chatbot can be set up in 30-60 minutes.
facts.quote: You can get a basic chatbot running in 30-60 minutes.

facts.fact: The article is dated March 16, 2026 and was marked as updated September 4, 2026.
facts.quote: Mar 16, 2026(updated / Sep 4, 2026)
